svg.title: European industrial GHG response: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM

cc:Work.dc:title: European industrial GHG response: OMNIA-ENGAGE and GCAM
cc:Work.dc:description: Reported European industrial GHG under NDC (left) and NDC+LTT (right). Panels a,b compare no, medium and high EU-only CE trajectories, with solid/open-circle OMNIA and dashed/filled-diamond GCAM lines at each model's supplied years from its historical reference onward. No interpolation, extrapolation or year displacement is used. OMNIA selects Emissions|GHG|Industry; GCAM sums Emissions|Kyoto Gases|Energy|Demand|Industry and Emissions|Kyoto Gases|Industrial Processes, both in Mt CO2-equiv/yr. These are source-defined industrial totals with different accounting scopes and potentially different gas coverage/GWP conventions, rather than harmonised sector totals. Panels c,d show signed 2050 CE-minus-no-CE changes, separately decomposed into OMNIA's cement, steel, aluminium and Other industry accounting residual, and GCAM's industrial energy demand and industrial processes. The component legends are model-specific; they do not imply a mapping between those categories. Positive and negative components stack independently from zero; black diamonds and signed labels give each model's net industrial change. Panels e,f show 100 × (CE − no CE) / no CE using each model's own source-defined industrial total in the same climate pathway and year. Both decomposition and percentage bars place OMNIA on the left and hatched GCAM on the right. Scales match across pathways within each row. Regional/partner decomposition from the reference Figure 7 is replaced because only EU-only data and unmatched sector emissions are available. Carbon capture is not subtracted again. OMNIA totals sum EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects its supplied EU-27 aggregate once, without adding country rows. These aggregates are checked against available-country sums. OMNIA regional boundaries include some small non-EU territories; membership is exported explicitly, so the two boundaries are not assumed identical. Source scenario names are retained: OMNIA baseline_* and GCAM LTT_* are displayed as NDC+LTT; ndc_* and NDC_* are displayed as NDC. Matching labels do not establish identical policy assumptions. OMNIA missing activity = zero (provisional); GCAM missing values remain gaps. Exact source variables, units, region memberships, conversion factors and calculation references accompany the source CSVs.
